Along with beauty services and a shared lounge, this comfortable hotel provides guests with currency exchange and a lift. The hotel offers a prime location, 4.5 km from Ha Noi railway station. Hanoi University is right near the Coco Hotel Cau Giay, while Doi dien 608 Duong Lang bus stop is nearly 5 minutes' walk away. Guests will also appreciate the vicinity to Phuc Thanh Garden, located 950 metres away. The modern Vietnamese Women's Museum is within 15 minutes' drive of this accommodation. Coco Hotel Cau Giay has 20 rooms with a dining area. A flat-screen TV with satellite channels along with a minibar fridge, tea and coffee making equipment are provided. Air conditioning are featured for guests' comfort. The modern private bathrooms are fitted with a bidet and a separate toilet. This Hanoi hotel offers a daily continental breakfast.
